Maria Davao Occidental Dear Ms. Depalubos: This is in reference to your letter dated 17 January 2019 requesting this Department's legal opinion on the following queries, viz: 1. Is it proper that the undersigned should remove Mr. Bolo from his being an SK Chairperson despite the absence of such order and using only the petition furnished by the COMELEC law department? 2. If' the order to deny due course is not available beyond the March 31st deadline of the conduct of the special SK elections, will Mr. Bolo continue to serve as SK chairperson on Brgy. Datu Intan despite the stipulated disqualification in the petition? In your first query, since you represented in your letter that what was furnished to you by the COMELEC is a mere Petition to Deny Due Course to and/or Cancel Certificate of Candidacy and not a COMELEC Order against SK Chairperson Bolo, this Department is of view that the said mere petition cannot be a basis from suspending his proclamation as there is yet no resolution of the case from COMELEC. Thus, it is not proper to remove Mr. Bolo from his Office and he should remain as the SK Chairperson despite said petition. However, if in case there is a COMELEC Order that will be issued to cancel his proclamation, the Department is inclined to abide with the COMELEC Order. As a consequence, pending the finality of the Order, the SK Official like Mr. Bolo will be treated as suspended from Office and the position of SK Chairperson will be considered temporarily vacant. Thereafter, the SK member who obtained the highest number of votes shall succeed

in the Office of SK Chairperson. However, since that the vacancy is only temporary, the said SK Member shall succeed in an acting capacity. Nevertheless, despite this Department's opinion, since the origin of this matter is a copy of a Petition to Deny Due Course to and/or Cancel Certificate of Candidacy from the COMELEC, it is therefore prudent that you coordinate with COMELEC in your Region/Province regarding the proper treatment of the herein case. In your second query, it must be noted that said conduct of election to fill-in vacancies in the SK was already suspended. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORIff OF THE SECRETA Y: TIN B.D -O Undersecretary Copy furnished: Dir. Alex C.
